body.statement: For every \(P\in\mathcal P_T\), \(Q_{P,c}\ll P\) on the observed trajectory space, conditional versions on \(P\)-null histories do not affect the target, and the causal incremental terminal mean is identified by \(\psi_T(P,c)=E_P[YW_T^P]=F_{T,c}(P)\).
body.justification: This proposition fixes the exact support-respecting observed-data functional before any minimax analysis.
body.gap: KimKennedyNaimi2021, Theorem 3.1, gives longitudinal identification with dropout; the present complete-data finite-tree formula makes null-prefix compatibility explicit for the unrestricted binary experiment.
body.consumer: The estimator and converse can operate on unconditional leaf and prefix masses without imposing treatment positivity.
